method: Area-weighted deterministic Lloyd clustering of canonical face+interpolated normal pairs, 24 iterations. Train only source height .955; inverse-transpose node normals and cofactor-transform face areas for each source height (no additional coefficients); validate original and other three source height ratios. No directional response fitted to screenshots.
runtimeCost: Per node two 3D dot products, abs, orientation sign, max, three scalar multiplies, two accumulates; one final reciprocal. 16 nodes: 32 dot products plus 16 branches/sign selections, no texture lookup. Occupancy/interception NOT validated by this unit-response gate.
